NativeExecutionSafetySuite qualified 5/5 on the actual native StudioSession, AppModel command/effect path and ExecutionService, under GITHUB_ACTIONS=true with explicit JDK25 and -Werror. Log /private/tmp/eyes4s-native-execution-safety-final.log; suite runtime 1.663 seconds. Tests cover actual FileProjectStore source-byte corruption after native preview blocking SaveAndRun before any run/job; tampered and stale backend-owned receipts failing the exact requested document run while a separate matching run99 remains Running and no backend/service job is allocated; app cancellation of the observed real native job without a fabricated JobHandle, actual backend Cancelled and document lifecycle settlement; two actual native runs with the old run's actual Changed/Ready events held until after the newer Ready, then delivered to verify newest requested/current/pending stamp and unchanged shown run.

The initial fifth-test source-IO gate incorrectly waited for a newer job behind the native submission synchronization mutex. Its timeout was a test assumption failure, not evidence of a production deadlock. Replaced it with the valid held-actual-event scenario; no backend, results, events or counts are fabricated. The revised regression independently qualifies the requestedStamp newest-run fix. The other four native tests passed before and after the correction.

Focused evidence only. No G1 closure, full adversarial catalogue closure, final combined-tree gate or pushed-SHA claim. Source frozen for integration.
